verdict.rationale: Instinct's docs say it proactively texts or calls users about dropped threads and summarizes emails. Reviewers confirm it nudges about forgotten items and spotted an overdue medical appointment from the user's data. Its 'no new interfaces' design means these insights arrive over text or call rather than an in-product insights surface, and they are mostly reminders, summaries and actions rather than analytical insights. Missing for 10: a documented in-product surface for insights and suggestions, analytical insight generation from connected data beyond summaries and reminders, and first-party docs detailing how suggestions are produced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: following up on threads you've dropped, proactively calling or texting you
summarizes an email received from your healthcare provider
it follows up on dropped threads and nudges you about forgotten items. In one case it noticed a tester was overdue for a medical appointment and booked it.
there are no new interfaces. It's trained to use a phone and a computer. You can text or call it.
